subject: problem with setPosition on a newly added node

messages.author: c60bcb6df5eb5536
messages.subject: problem with setPosition on a newly added node
parts:
Hi Paul,

I don't know if this is fixed in the current version of RCy, but in
RCy 1.4.4 (which I am using due to preparing a paper and not wanting
to change all the code and worrying about using a different version of
R and annotation packages)

when I try to add a node the Cytoscape and then change its position:
cw <- new.CytoscapeWindow ('setPosition.test', graph=makeSimpleGraph())
displayGraph (cw)
layout (cw)
setPosition (cw, c ('A', 'B', 'C'), c (10.0, 20.0, 500), c (0.0, 100.0, 3))

addCyNode(cw, "D")
setPosition(cw, "D", 10, 5)

I get the error:
Error! unknown nodes in RCytoscape::setPosition
D
NULL

I thought it might be due to not being in the graph that is in the
graph slot of the cw object, so I tried this:

addNode("D", cw@graph)
addCyNode(cw, "D")
setPosition(cw, "D", 10, 5)

And I still get the same error. Any way to add a new node and set its
position? Especially in RCy 1.4.4

Thanks,

-Robert

messages.author: c60bcb6df5eb5536
messages.subject: Re: problem with setPosition on a newly added node
parts:
Found the error:

cw@graph <- addNode("D", cw@graph) # need to actually save a new copy
of the graph

I really should have known better.

-Robert
